correction.text: Toniná, 13 km east of Ocosingo, Chiapas; the site 'on a platform covering 6 hectares'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; the 299-849 Maya envelope, bbox lon -93.8..-86.7, lat 13.6..21.6, covers it). The page gives only the site platform ('6 hectares') and no kingdom extent; 'Pomoy' defeated in 789 and a 'captive ... from the distant city of Calakmul' are the only places named. Drawn as a nominal 20 km disc (about 1,260 km2, five grid cells), soft.

region.text: Toniná, 13 km east of Ocosingo, Chiapas; the site 'on a platform covering 6 hectares'

ledger.note: 495: the first dated monument ('The dated monuments at Toniná span the period from AD 495 to 909'); the page gives no founding and an 8th-century text mentions a king 'ruling in AD 217' without a name.

region.text: Toniná, 13 km east of Ocosingo, Chiapas; the site 'on a platform covering 6 hectares'

ledger.note: 15 January 909: 'The last known recorded date at the site is featured on Monument 101'; 'By the time of Ruler 8's successor, Uh Chapat, Toniná was clearly in decline' and the infobox gives 'Abandoned: 10th century AD'.

wars.name: Toniná-Palenque wars
wars.outcome: September 687: Ruler 2 was possibly 'defeat[ed] and captur[ed] by K'inich Kan Balam II of Palenque'; 'in 711, while Ruler 4 was still a child, Toniná gained an important victory over Palenque'; 'around 764 Toniná defeated Palenque in battle'. No land change is recorded.
wars.note: The palenque dossier records the 711 sack; the page names the Palenque king 'Kan Joy Chitam II'.

wars.name: Toniná-Piedras Negras war
wars.outcome: 'Around 725 Toniná fought a war against Piedras Negras, a city on the north bank of the Usumacinta River, now in Guatemala.' No outcome or land change is stated.

sources.title: Toniná
sources.note: Dated monuments 495 to 909; Ruler 2 captured September 687; Palenque victory 711; Piedras Negras war around 725; Palenque c.764; Pomoy 789; Monument 101 on 15 January 909; platform 6 ha.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Toniná row. The page has no founding date: 495 is the first dated monument; 909 the last Long Count date (Monument 101, 15 January 909); abandonment 'in the 10th century'.
COUNTERPARTS. Palenque has a dossier; Piedras Negras is written in this batch; Pomoy (defeated 789) has none. The 633 installation of 'two subordinate lords' by K'inich Hix Chapat is not an event because the land is not named.
GAZETTEER. 'Toniná' and 'Ocosingo' are not in the gazetteer; the disc uses the page's coordinates.
